description: This file defines a LightningJS component called 'NoteCard' which visually represents a note with its title, update time, snippet, and action buttons ('Edit' and 'Delete'). It manages internal state, synchronizes with passed-in 'note' data, and emits events for editing and deleting the note.

classes.name: NoteCard
classes.description: A LightningJS component to display a note with interactive editing and deletion options.

methods.name: sync
methods.description: Synchronizes internal state with the 'note' data object, setting title, snippet, and last updated text.

methods.name: edit
methods.description: Emits an 'edit' event with the current note data to signal editing action.

methods.name: del
methods.description: Emits a 'delete' event with the note's ID to signal deletion.
